meta.name: doc-parse
meta.description: 将 PDF/PPT/Excel/Word 等多格式文档解析为结构化 Markdown，并输出元数据与解析置信度，作为 RAG 与四色卡片的数据底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PDF/PPT/Excel/Word 文档解析为结构化 Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要把各种办公文档转成结构化文本，供知识库或检索使用
copy.tagline_en: Parse PDF, PPT, Excel and Word into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convert various office documents into clean structured Markdown for reuse

howto.what: 把 PDF、PPT、Excel、Word 等文档解析成结构化 Markdown，同时给出标题、页数等元数据、0–1 的解析置信度，以及实际生效的解析器名称。
howto.when: 当密卷房 Worker 收到已通过安全扫描的文件时被调用；也可直接运行 scripts/run_doc_parse.py 触发。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 解析成 Markdown，并给出置信度
say.note: 输出正文、元数据与实际生效的解析器

say.text: 解析这个 Excel，告诉我表格数和解析置信度
say.note: 来自 metadata 与 confidence 字段

say.text: 这份文件要人工介入吗？解析器试到哪一档
say.note: 三级全失败会回传 BLOCKED 并标记人工介入

howto.what_en: Turns PDF, PPT, Excel, Word and other documents into structured Markdown, and returns metadata such as title and page count, a 0–1 parsing confidence, and the name of the parser that finally ran.
howto.when_en: Runs when the Mijuanfang Worker receives a file that already passed the security scan; you can also trigger it directly by running scripts/run_doc_parse.py.

say_en.text: Parse this PDF into Markdown and give me the confidence score
say_en.note: Returns body, metadata and the parser used

say_en.text: Parse this Excel file; report table count and parsing confidence
say_en.note: From the metadata and confidence fields

say_en.text: Does this file need manual review, and which parser tier ran?
say_en.note: Three failed tiers return BLOCKED and mark manual review
